# API Documentation

The API supports authentication using API keys and OAuth 2.0.

The API rate limit is 100 requests per minute.

If a user exceeds the rate limit, the API returns HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.

Webhook delivery logs are retained for 7 days.

Customer data can be deleted upon request, with deletion completed within 30 days.

# Pricing

The platform offers three plans: Free, Pro, and Enterprise.

The Free plan is available to individual developers and startups.

The Pro plan costs $29 per month.

Enterprise pricing is customized based on usage.
